title: Job actions
description: Cancel, retry (resubmit with same params), remediate. Confirmation dialogs. Audit entry on action.
definitionOfDone: Retry button (resubmits with same params) with confirmation
Actions disabled based on job state (can't cancel completed jobs)

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/jobs/JobActions.tsx: Action buttons for job detail page. Props: job (Job type). Buttons: Cancel (danger variant, disabled if job is in terminal state: succeeded/failed/cancelled), Retry (outline variant, always enabled for completed jobs), Remediate (subtle variant, if applicable). Each button opens a confirmation dialog (simple modal with message + confirm/cancel buttons). On confirm: calls useCancelJob() or useRetryJob() mutation. Success: show success toast/banner and invalidate cache. Error: show error message. Dialog component is a simple reusable ConfirmDialog.

Create dashboard/src/components/ui/ConfirmDialog.tsx: Reusable confirmation dialog. Props: open, onConfirm, onCancel, title, message, confirmLabel, confirmVariant (Button variant). Modal overlay with Card containing title, message, and action buttons.
Integrate JobActions into JobDetailPage.tsx header section.

implementationPlan.note: tsc --noEmit passes. Also fixed pre-existing CommandPalette ref error (used native input instead of non-forwardRef Input component).

reopenReason:
DoD items 2 and 3 FAIL — Only Cancel is implemented; Retry and Remediate are missing.

JobActions.tsx only has a Cancel button (lines 85-94). The DoD requires:

**Retry button (item 2):** Must add a Retry button that resubmits the job with the same params. `useRetryJob` hook already exists in `hooks/useJobs.ts` (line 183). Add:
- A Retry button (outline variant) enabled for terminal-state jobs (failed, timeout, denied)
- A ConfirmDialog for retry confirmation
- A handleRetry callback calling `retryMutation.mutate(job.id, ...)`

**Remediate action (item 3):** Add a Remediate button for jobs in `approval_required` or `denied` state. This could call a POST to approve/override the job, or if no backend endpoint exists, at minimum provide a button that navigates to the approvals flow.

The plan step-1 explicitly describes: "Cancel (danger variant), Retry (outline variant, always enabled for completed jobs), Remediate (subtle variant, if applicable)" but only Cancel was implemented.
